products.name: Splice
products.note: Mobile video editing; music licensing; content creation; GoPro ownership

profile_text.body:
Splice is a New York-based music production platform that describes itself as the industry's highest quality royalty-free sample library, offering access to millions of sounds made by top artists, labels, and sound designers. Its core catalog allows producers to search, preview, and use samples, loops, and sound effects, and the platform also provides royalty-free presets including a partnership with Xfer Records around that company's wavetable synthesizer. Splice makes its catalog available through a dedicated plugin called the Sounds Plugin, which integrates directly into a digital audio workstation so users can drag and drop sounds into their projects without leaving their software.

The company also offers Splice Mobile, a companion app that lets users discover and record song ideas on a phone and then export stems to a DAW or share them with collaborators. Additional features include free preset drops distributed on a monthly basis. The held facts categorize Splice under video generation and editing, noting mobile video editing, music licensing, content creation, and a GoPro ownership connection, though the company's own website focuses squarely on audio samples, presets, and music production tools. The site's data associates Splice with 260 legal matters in New York, though no specific case details are provided.
